sloka: शिला वर्षम् महत् तस्याः शर वर्षेण राघवः ।प्रतिवार्यो अपधावन्त्याः करौ चिच्छेद पत्रिभिः ॥१-२६-१७॥
transliteration: śilā varṣam mahat tasyāḥ śara varṣeṇa rāghavaḥ ।prativāryo apadhāvantyāḥ karau ciccheda patribhiḥ ॥1-26-17॥

translations.english: Rama retaliated that mighty rain of rocks with a volley of arrows. While she was advancing towards him, he cut off her hands.
